title: Root test command skips desktop smoke coverage

evidence.quote: "test": "echo 'desktop: covered by smoke test (pnpm smoke) and core tests'"
"test": "echo 'ui: rendered via desktop app; no unit tests yet'"

reasoning: The workspace-level pnpm test delegates to package test scripts, but the desktop and UI package tests are successful echo commands. The actual desktop smoke check exists as a separate script and is not invoked by pnpm test, so any automation or developer relying on the standard test command gets a false green for renderer boot and UI integration coverage.
reproduction: Run pnpm test; the desktop and UI packages report success without executing apps/desktop's smoke script.
recommendation: Either include the desktop smoke script in the root test/verification command, or add a clearly named root verify script and ensure CI and documentation use that as the authoritative gate instead of pnpm test alone.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The package test scripts themselves are the gap: they exit successfully without running the smoke check or UI assertions.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CI check that runs the intended root verification command and fails unless the desktop smoke command executes.
minimumFixScope: Root test/verification scripts and the desktop/UI package test script wiring.
